title: Mark Clark's secret landing
body:
Before dawn, U.S. General Mark Clark slipped ashore from the British submarine HMS Seraph near Cherchell, Algeria.

At a secret meeting he asked French officers to help, not fight, the Allied landings in North Africa planned for November.
photoNote: Official U.S. Army portrait of Mark W. Clark, taken after the war (he wears four stars; in 1942 he was a major general). U.S. government work, public domain. No public domain photo of the Cherchell meeting itself was found.
